findings.title: Machine-readable content does not identify a target audience
findings.evidence: No target-audience language (e.g. 'for small businesses', 'built for teams') found across 2 key pages checked

evidence_detail.observation: No target-audience language (e.g. 'for small businesses', 'built for teams') found across 2 key pages checked

suggested_action.summary: Add explicit audience-framing language to the homepage or about page (e.g. who the product/service is designed for) so both humans and AI agents can match the right visitor to the right offering.

findings.title: Machine-readable content does not establish where the business operates
findings.evidence: No address, phone number, or structured 'address' property found across 23 crawled pages

evidence_detail.observation: No address, phone number, or structured 'address' property found across 23 crawled pages

suggested_action.summary: Publish at least one machine-readable location or contact signal (address, phone, or structured-data address property) — relevant even for online-only businesses (e.g. a registered jurisdiction or support contact).
